english: Perseverance prevails; Three years on a stone
example_japanese: 彼は毎日練習を続けて、ついにプロになった。まさに石の上にも三年。
example_english: He practiced every day and finally went pro. Truly, perseverance prevails.
explanation: Even sitting on a cold stone, three years of patience will warm it. Consistent effort always pays off.
cultural_note: This proverb reflects the Japanese value of ganbaru (doing ones best consistently over time).
